tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lhag pa'i lha bka' sdod du bcas pa la gtor ma 'bul ba'i cho ga nyung ngu don 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs so// skal ba bzang pos ring nas mgron gnyer ba'i// lhag pa lha yi snying grogs bslu med gang*// mchod gtor bstabs pas rgyal ba kun dgyes nas// dngos grub bde blag 'grub 'gyur khyad par chos// de tshul rgyas pa'i bshul ring bgrod pa med// bsdus che som nyi'i 'phrang lam ma dpyangs par// bar ma'i nye lam la 'jug gtor 'bul gyi// cho ga nyung ngu don 'dus rnam par bskrun// de la mchod gtor spyi ltar bshams nas yi dam kye rdo rje'am rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs gang yin gyi bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas/ yi dam gyi gtor 'bul rgyun 'khyer btang na/ gtor ma byin rlabs yi dam gang yin gyi nang mchod ltar bsang sbyangs nas brtsams te ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum brjod pa'i bar byas/ thog mar kye rdo rje la/ nam mkhar e las chos 'byung ni// sum brtsegs pad+ma 'dab brgyad bcas// steng mar oṃ dgu las byung ba'i// sku yi rdo rje lha chen brgyad// dkar po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// bar ma'i lte bar hūm̐ aṃ las// snying po kye yi rdo rje sngo// zhal brgyad g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad kyi// thod pas srog chags brgyad len cing*// g.yon brgyad lha chen ster tshul 'dzin// bdag med sngo bsangs gri gug dang*// thod pa can 'khyud zhabs bzhi pos// brkyang bskum gar gyi stabs su bzhengs// gnyis ka'ang mgo phreng rus pa'i brgyan// phyogs mtshams gaṃ sogs sa bon skyes// gau rī tsau rī be ta lī// za phod sbos mo sha wa rī// gdol mo g.yung mo brgyad po ni// sku mdog phyag mtshan tha dad 'dzin// thod phreng rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan// g.yon brkyang gar gyi stabs su bzhengs// 'dab brgyad pad+mar hūm̐ las skyes// phyogs skyong brgyad sngo rdo dril 'dzin// 'og ma'i pad+mar āḥdagu las// gsung gi rdo rje klu chen brgyad// dmar po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// kun kyang g.yas brkyang rus pas brgyan// bdag gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis// sa gsum 'gro ba kun bsdus nas// brgyad gsum 'byung po so sor bstim// mig rnams gti mug rdo rje ma// rna bar zhe sdang snar ser sna// lce la 'dod chags lus phrag dog

/gnas gsum rdo rje gsum bdag nyid// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams// rang 'drar byon nas dbyer med 'dres// slar yang rigs lnga'i rgyal bas byon// dbang bskur stsol cig gsol btab pas// sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// badz+rī bha wā bhi ṣiñtsa/ zhes gsung dbang bskur sku lus gang*// chu yi lhag ma lud pa las// sku yi lha tshogs rnam snang mdzad// gtso bo phyogs skyong mi bskyod pa// gsung gi lha tshogs 'od dpag med// lha mo brgyad la rdor sems brgyan// oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi ti hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma bzhes par bsams la/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra/ oṃ in+da dza ma dza la sogs nas/ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar lan gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ kye rdor sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i// lha tshogs zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// zhes pas nang mchod 'bul/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang*/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs dang*/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// zhes sogs sam/ de mi nus na/ bde gshegs sku gsung thugs rdo rje// sa gsum 'byung po'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// bar chad zhi dang bsrung mdzad cing*// 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol la bstod// lhag pa'i lha dang 'byung po'i tshogs// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces so// mkha' spyod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang*/

phaiṃ/ snying ga'i 'od kyis rang bzhin gyi// gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mo chos skyong ba// 'jig rten skyong bcas 'dir gshegs shig /ces spyan drangs/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī yai/ badz+ra bar+ṇa nī yai/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī yai hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ nang mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun du rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag dang sems can thams cad ni// dag pa mkha' spyod 'khrid du gsol// zhes so// rdo rje 'jigs byed la/ slar yang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum brjod/ nam mkhar paṃ las pad+ma dang*// a las zla bar dhīḥlas ni// 'jam dpal gzhon nu gser gyi mdog /zhi 'dzum ral gri glegs bam 'dzin// rgyan rdzogs rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// thugs kar āḥlas nyi mar gyur// 'od 'phros 'phags pa'i tshogs bskul bas// gshin rje'i gshed rnams spyan drangs bstim// 'od phung zhu ba de yis kyang*// 'phags pa'i gsung rnams dbyangs gsal sngags// rang sgra sgrogs pa bkug cing bstim// hūm̐ mthing gyur pa'i 'od zer gyis// rgyal ba rgyal ba'i sras kyi thugs// phyag mtshan tshul bkug thim pa na// khro bo'i rdo rje hūm̐ mtshan gyur// hūm̐ gi 'od kyis snod bcud sbyangs// rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor byas// tshur 'dus khro bo'i rgyal po che// rdo rje 'jigs byed gyur pa ni// zhal dgu rtsa zhal ma he'i gdong*// kun kyang spyan gsum khro ba'i nyams// sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag rnams kyis// bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin// brkyang bskum bcu drug zhabs kyi 'og

/srog chags brgyad brgyad tshangs pa dbang*// nye dbang drag po gdong drug mnan// chags can 'dul ba'i mtshan ma bsgreng*// mgo phreng rus rgyan sbrul gyis brgyan// ye shes me klong gar dgus bsgyings// dpral mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐// mig ni sa snying sna nam snying*// rna ba gsang bdag lce gar dbang*// lus ni sgrib sel yid kun bzang*// thugs ka'i sa bon 'od 'phros pas// rang bzhin gnas nas dpal chen por// sangs rgyas byang sems zhi dang khro// yum bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ /mchod ma brgyad kyis mchod nas ni// dbang bskur stsol cig gsol btab pas// sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// badz+ro da ka bhi ṣiñtsa/ su ra ti s+t+waṃ a haṃ zhes/ dbang bskur dri bral khro bo'i rgyal// dbang thob mi bskyod spyi bor brgyan// dbang lha ye shes 'khor lo'i tshul// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabyer med gyur// gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya sogs dang*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥbi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba bi gh+nān sha trūn mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes lan gsum mam lngas phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di sogs kyis yid byung*/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan sogs kyis bstod/ gshin rje'i gshed po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces brjod/ bar 'dir gur mgon/ zhal bzhi/ las mgon sogs la 'bul ba ni kho bos logs su bris pa ltar ro// dam can chos rgyal la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha hoḥhrīḥ/ mdun du pad+ma nyi ma dang*// ma he'i steng du ya las ni// dbyug pa ya yis mtshan pa las// las kyi gshin rje ma he'i gdong*// nag po thod dbyug zhags pa 'dzin// dur khrod chas brgyan liṅga bsgreng*// me dpung dbus su g.yon brkyang bzhugs// g.yon du hrīḥdang rtse gsum skyes// 'chi bdag nag mo tsā muṇ+ḍi// rtse gsum thod pa khrag bkang bsnams// lto 'phyang nu rgyas rus rgyan can// ba lang ko rlon gos su gyon// 'jigs rung gshin rje'i 'khor gyis bskor// gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis spras// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros lho yi phyogs// gshin rje'i grong nas las gshin rje// 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ// zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrgyal ba lngas// rdo rje'i chu dbang bskur ro zhes// dbang bskur rtags su rdo rjes brgyan// sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ dhū paṃ swā hā/ dī paṃ swā hā/ gan+dhaṃ swā hā/ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sarba bi gh+nān sha trūn mā ra ya/ i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ hūm̐ 'chi bdag nag po lha phyogs kyi sogs nas/ rdul phran tsam yang med par gyis// zhes so// beg tse la btang na 'dir 'jug 'jig rten pa la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki n+yaḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ/ gdod nas grub pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams byon par bsams la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsi/ ung+mā da/ a pasmā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da yaḥ.i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ yathai baṃ/ yathaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ dzi gha tha/ pi ba tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sar+b+ba kārta ya/ sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dhaḥs ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/

lan gsum/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pād+yaṃ swā hā sogs nas shab+da swā hās/ phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ bstan pa srung dang 'gro don mdzad// dam bcas zhal gyis 'ches pa rnams// dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar myur// 'jigs gzugs drag gtum mi bzad pa// gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag phyogs 'joms// rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu 'byin// mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam mi khyab// gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la bstod// sde brgyad btsun mo sras g.yog bcas// dngos grub kun drin bdag la stsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe ring dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// dge legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /kye rdor bde mchog ltar na rdo rje'i glu bsngo ba bkra shis bcas bya'o// yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ ma 'byor pa sogs dang*/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/

oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hās me tog 'thor/ rten med pa rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang gi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma zhes sam/ dpral bar oṃ sogs skabs su gang bab kyi bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bya ba rnams byas pas don grub bo// rnam dkar dge bas deng nas byang chub bar// rnam mkhyen bla ma lha srung mchod byed cing*// rnam dag gzhung lugs thos bsam mthar phyin nas// rnam 'dren bstan la sman 'dogs byed par shog /ces yi dam bka' sdod du bcas pa la gtor ma 'bul ba'i cho ga nyung ngu don 'dus zhes bya ba 'di ni/ par dpon tshul khrims ting 'dzin pas bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
